blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The impeachment court suspended proceedings Thursday morning as the defense panel objected to the prosecution’s request to present a forensic financial analyst ahead of the Bureau of Internal Revenue (BIR) witness originally scheduled to testify. The prosecution through Bicol Saro party-list Rep. Terry Ridon, sought to call forensic financial analyst lawyer Alexander Cabrera instead of a BIR representative as the presenting counsel, Erwin Matib, was reportedly unable to appear because of health reasons.
